<span class="hl-kw">from</span> __future__ <span class="hl-kw">import</span> annotations
<span class="hl-kw">from</span> typing <span class="hl-kw">import</span> <span class="hl-type">Any</span>, <span class="hl-type">Literal</span>
<span class="hl-kw">from</span> dataclasses <span class="hl-kw">import</span> dataclass


<span class="hl-comment">@dataclass(frozen=True)</span>
<span class="hl-kw">class</span> UserCreatedData:
    payload: <span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>]
    value: <span class="hl-type">str</span> | <span class="hl-type">float</span> | <span class="hl-type">bool</span>
    dup: <span class="hl-type">int</span> | <span class="hl-type">float</span> | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    list_of: <span class="hl-type">list</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span> | <span class="hl-kw">None</span>] | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    null_first: <span class="hl-type">str</span> | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    all_null: <span class="hl-type">Literal</span>[] | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    nested_any: <span class="hl-type">str</span> | <span class="hl-type">int</span> | <span class="hl-type">bool</span> | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    plain: <span class="hl-type">str</span> | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>

    @classmethod
    <span class="hl-kw">def</span> from_dict(<span class="hl-kw">cls</span>, data: <span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>]) -&gt; UserCreatedData:
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">cls</span>(
            payload=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;payload&quot;</span>),
            value=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;value&quot;</span>),
            dup=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;dup&quot;</span>),
            list_of=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;listOf&quot;</span>),
            null_first=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;nullFirst&quot;</span>),
            all_null=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;allNull&quot;</span>),
            nested_any=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;nestedAny&quot;</span>),
            plain=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;plain&quot;</span>),
        )

    <span class="hl-kw">def</span> to_dict(<span class="hl-kw">self</span>) -&gt; <span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>]:
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> {
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;payload&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.payload,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;value&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.value,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;dup&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.dup,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;listOf&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.list_of,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;nullFirst&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.null_first,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;allNull&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.all_null,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;nestedAny&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.nested_any,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;plain&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.plain,
        }
